gaps.explanation: pp10-11 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints five enterprise columns (p10 Electric, Water, Sewer; p11 Trash, Landfill); none is in detail[] (Internal Service Fund column not used). JSON receipts = Sales 4,929,416 + Occupation taxes 145,636 + Other revenue 128,277 + Interest income 38,745 + Grant income 209,996 + Loss on disposal (547) = 5,451,523. By column: Electric 3,038,902 + 116,676 + 78,511 + 30,059 - 547 = 3,263,601; Water 711,272 + 28,960 + 17,654 = 757,886; Sewer 432,292 + 209,996 = 642,288; Trash 210,786 + 4,095 = 214,881; Landfill 536,164 + 28,017 + 8,686 = 572,867. Sum 5,451,523 = statement total.
